outages.description: A NamPower substation fault caused a power outage and a significant drop in Internet traffic across central, coastal and southern Namibia.
Fiber optic cuts on ANTEL's (AS6057) national backbone caused a near-total loss of its HTTP request traffic in eastern Uruguay.
A magnitude 7.7 earthquake caused a significant drop in Internet traffic across Panama
Yandex, Russia's biggest internet company, shut down its data centers in Sasovo, Ryazan, and later in Vladimir after drone strikes damaged both facilities.
